title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: transitionfn
text:
transition function
transition function
(definition)
Definition:
A function of the current
state
and input giving the
next state
of a
finite state machine
or
Turing machine
.
Note:
This defines the set of
transitions
.
